title: Test-function normalization of a continuous-set realization morphism
statement: Use compatible universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] in universe $u$ and $D$ a topological space in universe $u+1$. Use the sheaves $F_{D,X}$ [def-sfb-continuous-set-sheaf] and $\underline D$ [def-sfb-continuous-set-profinite-sheaf]. Let $a(S)=\operatorname{Spec}\operatorname{LC}(S,\mathbf Z)$ and $p_X^*=\pi_X^{-1}a^*$ be the specified point inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-point-pullback], where $\pi_X:X\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$. Define its specified adjunction to be the composite [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] of the sheafified-left-Kan-extension adjunction $a^*\dashv a_*$ and the scheme adjunction $\pi_X^{-1}\dashv\pi_{X*}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For each profinite $S$, define $r_{X,S}$ on the chosen relative test object $a(S)\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}X$ by the first pullback projection followed by the inverse of the evaluation-prime homeomorphism $S\times\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z\simeq|a(S)|$ and then projection to $S$; this is the label map of [lem-sfb-relative-profinite-test-labels]. Define a morphism $\sigma:p_X^*\underline D\to F_{D,X}$ to be normalized if its transpose under that composite adjunction has, for every profinite $S$ and every $b\in C(S,D)$, value $b\circ r_{X,S}$. This is a predicate on an arbitrary supplied morphism; it neither chooses a realization nor requires its invertibility or any separation or disconnectedness hypothesis on $D$.
